about: Pure-Ergo producer qualification, semantic version checking, and Mach-O signature guards.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-producer-require-empty
mutants.rule: Producer Require must fail when expected qualification does not match the artifact qualifier.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-producer-universal-accepted
mutants.rule: Universal fat Mach-O images must be refused explicitly rather than accepted or treated as thin headers.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-producer-version-leading-zero
mutants.rule: Semantic version components with leading zeroes must be rejected.
